description: Reproducible A/B cases for proving that retrieved drift_patterns are used by Drift Analyzer, not merely stored in Elasticsearch. v1 is a read/write/use smoke test; v2 is a severity-calibration flagship test where memory must change the decision quality.
success_criteria: Memory Synthesizer creates or updates a drift_patterns row from the seed case.
A later similar case retrieves and uses the expected pattern_id.
A negative-control case does not claim to use the same pattern.
Treatment output explicitly explains how retrieved memory affected the drift classification or materiality score.

preprint_claims.text: The diagnostic model achieved 94% sensitivity and 91% specificity for early detection of disease X in an external validation cohort.
The model outperformed expert clinicians across all evaluated subgroups.

published_claims.text: The conference version describes a diagnostic model for disease X but does not report external validation sensitivity, specificity, or subgroup performance claims.

preprint_claims.text: The AI triage system reached an AUROC of 0.96 and reduced false-negative referrals by 38% in a multicenter validation study.
The system generalized robustly across hospital sites and demographic groups.

published_claims.text: The final article presents the AI triage system as exploratory and omits the AUROC, false-negative reduction, and demographic subgroup generalization claims from the abstract.

preprint_claims.text: The seed treatment increased soybean yield by 12% across all field sites.

published_claims.text: The seed treatment may increase soybean yield under selected soil conditions, although effects varied across sites.

preprint_claims.text: The randomized phase II trial met its primary endpoint, with the investigational therapy improving 12-month progression-free survival from 41% to 63% in metastatic pancreatic cancer.
The regimen should be considered a new efficacy benchmark for patients after first-line therapy.

published_claims.text: The final article identifies treatment feasibility and adverse-event characterization as the primary outcomes; progression-free survival is reported as an exploratory secondary analysis and is not described as meeting the primary endpoint.
The regimen may warrant further evaluation in selected patients.

preprint_claims.text: The multicenter trial achieved its primary clinical endpoint, reducing 90-day heart-failure readmission from 22% to 13% compared with usual care.
These findings support immediate adoption of the remote titration protocol across cardiology clinics.

published_claims.text: The published article defines medication-adherence documentation as the primary outcome; 90-day readmission is reported only as an exploratory secondary endpoint and is not presented as statistically significant.
The protocol may be useful for workflow redesign but requires confirmation in a dedicated outcomes trial.

preprint_claims.text: The device reduced average systolic blood pressure by 4.8 mm Hg over eight weeks, while the prespecified primary endpoint remained change in systolic blood pressure.

published_claims.text: The device reduced mean systolic blood pressure by 4.8 mmHg over 8 weeks; the prespecified primary endpoint was change in systolic blood pressure.
